ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Portfolio outcome, Exit process and later stages need Latest valuation and Lead partner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Active", 1, "Follow-on review", 2, "Exit preparation", 3, "Exit process", 4, "Exited", 5, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Latest_valuation__c), ISBLANK(Lead_partner__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Latest valuation and Lead partner before moving to Exit process.
